focus_area: Frontend view components — SPEC §8.2–§8.5, §10. Files: JobSetupAiSettings.tsx, components/JobCriteriaSection.tsx, JobCriteriaViewModal.tsx, RegenerateJobCriteriaConfirmModal.tsx, jobCriteriaTiers.ts.

findings.title: Dead `history` prop threaded into JobCriteriaSection but never used (vestige of the superseded props.history.push navigation)
findings.spec_requirement: SPEC §8.3 originally specified intro-link navigation 'via props.history.push', but the adjudicated qa-run-1 fix batch item 3 superseded that with a react-router `<Link to={...}>`. No current spec/DECISIONS/adjudicated ruling calls for threading `history` into the section component. Per BRIEF Layer-1 rule: 'Diff-to-spec: every change in your assigned area must trace to SPEC / DECISIONS / Reviewed Plan / an adjudicated ruling. Untraceable = finding.'
findings.evidence: components/JobCriteriaSection.tsx:22 declares `history: any` in the Props interface, and JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107 passes `history={props.history}` into `<JobCriteriaSection job={passedJob} history={props.history} />`. The component destructures only `{ job }` (JobCriteriaSection.tsx:25) and never reads `history` anywhere (grep of the file finds `history` only at line 22, the type declaration). Navigation is done entirely by `<Link to={`/jobs/${job.id}/setup/description`}>` (JobCriteriaSection.tsx:40), which does not need `history`. The prop and its threading are dead code left over from the pre-adjudication `props.history.push` approach.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused `history: any` field from the Props interface (JobCriteriaSection.tsx:22) and drop `history={props.history}` from the parent call site (JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107). Minimal, behavior-preserving cleanup of a superseded-spec remnant.
